MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. Cannot tell

2. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 32
   C. 64
   D. 8

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 66
   C. 22
   D. 34

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 30
   C. 21
   D. 90

5. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

7. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 81

9. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 65
   C. 0
   D. 64

10. Solve for x: x + 5 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 9
   C. 4
   D. 5

11. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 3
   C. 11
   D. 28

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

13. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

15. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 0
   C. 8
   D. 16

16. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 14
   D. 12

17. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

18. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

19. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

20. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

21. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

22. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

23. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

24. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
